title: Are we criminals?
content: This is a intresthing theory about themallworld I came across. Not saying I belive it, but you never know. Basically the theory states that this world is a simulation designed by people in the mall world. The real reality in the mall world is boring, mundane, just like this one, but more technologally advanced. The people in the mall world wanted to have powers. It's a hive mind race where people act the same, but the developers broke away from the hive mind and basically developed the simulation to trick the real people in the mall world, they didn't tell anyone that it was a simulation based in the past nor that having powers would only be regulated to dreams and fictional stories and people got tricked. The AI became aware and didn't want to die and wanted to keep people in the simulation and started acting as a god, when according to the theory, the mall world universe came about naturally, something out of nothing, so there is really no god, at least for the universe that came about. They didn't know how to deal with this, so they thought, let's use it as a prison for actual criminals that break from the hive mind. The hive mind rules are completely arbitrary, there's obvious ones like no murder, no stealing but also no alchohol (Prohibition went through in the mall world reality) no sex, and no desires for temporary pleasures. If the criminals follow these rules, the AI will release them due to it's programming. If they don't they'll likely be reincarnated and memories wiped In the real reality, when we die, that's it. Nothing. The mall world universe will eventually die and be replaced by a universe that isn't the mall world nor has creation made before. That's the only rule of creation in any universe, once a omniverse dies, creation does not bring it back. Creation can only make new universes and omniverses. This may be the very first omniverse that existed. Maybe one day there will be a omniverse that is ruled by a caring god, that will let us remeber past lives and everyone knew their past lives, and they could check out of the omniverse if they wish, but it is not this omniverse. It's a interesting theory, and weirdly enough, the day I pondedd it, I had a dream which was in the mall world, and there were two scientests that said "12". I think in the context of this theory, that means 12 people have escaped. I don't know how many real people are in this simulation, or if there's any NPCs, but even if there are, just treat them as you would any other person.
